Putin shared his feelings on Russian achievements In an interview with Emir Kusturica for the film "Our Baptism. The Primate," marking Patriarch Kirill's 80th birthday, Vladimir Putin stated that he experiences genuine delight when observing the successes of Russian scientists, artists, and athletes. "I feel as if these talented people are close to me, almost family members. I perceive their success as a personal victory," Putin said. He also expressed deep gratitude for the support of the Russian people, noting that without it, achieving common goals for Russia would be impossible. @Slavyangrad

They did whatever they could in a very difficult field. But in the West, most people think that you just went there to murder children or to murder innocent people.
